current_activity: LVIII Panzer Corps takes over responsibility at Mortain from the XLVII Panzer Corps
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 25 p. 502: on 12 August the XLVII Panzer Corps headquarters turned over its responsibility at Mortain to the LVIII Panzer Corps and went to Argentan; p. 482: the LVIII Corps, with the 10th SS Panzer Division, had been inserted at Barenton to relieve the weak 275th Division and protect the 2d SS Panzer Division flank. Location: Mortain sector, named as the responsibility passed to the corps. Location approximate: the corps command post is not named; the point is Mortain, precision 10 km.

current_activity: The right wing of the LVIII Panzer Corps attacks at 0700 for the high ground southeast of Juvelize
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 5 p. 230: Balck "set 0700 the next morning as H Hour for an attack by the right wing of the LVIII Panzer Corps. This attack aimed at the seizure of the high ground southeast of Juvelize"; the day is 22 September (p. 229-230: Balck took over on 21 September). Event definition: the attack of 22 September, which failed against CCA of the 4th Armored Division (tank battles of 19-22 September, p. 233). Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Juvelize with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the objective area of the right wing; the corps headquarters is not placed. Location support: CMH names the objective. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US 4th Armored Division CCA.

notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 8 p. 174: "the LVIII Panzer Corps' mission was to cross the Our River on both sides of Ouren, drive west on the Houffalize axis"; p. 195: "one armored division, the 116th Panzer Division, and two-thirds of an infantry division, the 560th Volks Grenadier Division"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "LVIII Panzer Corps: General der Panzertruppen W.
